ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

17. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

21. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

22. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Heat and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of heat in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Dangers of heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Harmonious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Safe and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Safe Travel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
